# Strata

> Strata is a personal workspace for tasks, an agenda, pages, whiteboards, spending and files in one place. It is free and open source, from Project Graphite.

Everything except the pages below needs an account. Shared spaces let a few people work on the same tasks, pages and boards.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://strata.project-graphite.com/): what Strata is
- [Sign in](https://strata.project-graphite.com/login)
- [Create an account](https://strata.project-graphite.com/register)
- [Privacy](https://strata.project-graphite.com/privacy): what is stored and for how long
- [Terms](https://strata.project-graphite.com/terms)

## API

Signed-in users can create personal access tokens under Settings, Developer, which also lists every route by scope. Requests go to `https://strata.project-graphite.com/api/v1` with the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Source

- [Project Graphite on GitHub](https://github.com/Project-Graphite)
